description: Cameroon Pidgin English rental for land in Kribi

messages.text: Hello, I wan get land for rent for Kribi o.
How much you fit pay every month for the land?
You want small land or big land? Which size you dey find?
Make e be small, around 200 square metres.
Which area for Kribi you prefer?
Dombe side, I like that place.
Which time you wan start to use the land?
Next year for January, God willing.
You want make I register this search? I go keep am for you.
Yes, register am make I no forget.
Your search don register well. We go contact you.
